log.asked:
Task: A ball rolls from spot 1 to spot 4, one spot per step. A screen can hide spots 2 and 3. We only see where the ball is when it is not hidden. Predict what we see.

Things and states to use:
  screen: down, up
  seen: at 1, at 2, at 3, at 4, nothing
Events to use: (none)

The checker will test your model on these jobs:
- "no screen, ends at 4": start with screen is down, seen is at 1; no events; expected at the end: seen is at 4.
- "no screen, seen at 3 on step 3": start with screen is down, seen is at 1; no events; expected at step 3: seen is at 3.
- "screen up, ends at 4": start with screen is up, seen is at 1; no events; expected at the end: seen is at 4.
- "screen up, nothing on step 2": start with screen is up, seen is at 1; no events; expected at step 2: seen is nothing.
- "screen up, nothing on step 3": start with screen is up, seen is at 1; no events; expected at step 3: seen is nothing.

Here is a model for this task. It may contain mistakes, including mistakes the jobs above do not catch.

{"things":{"screen":["down","up"],"seen":["at 1","at 2","at 3","at 4","nothing"]},"events":[],"start":{"screen":"down","seen":"at 1"},"rules":[{"name":"a","when":["seen is at 1","screen is down"],"then":"seen is at 2","made_by":"guesser first guess"},{"name":"b","when":["seen is at 2"],"then":"seen is at 3","made_by":"guesser first guess"},{"name":"c","when":["seen is at 3"],"then":"seen is at 4","made_by":"guesser first guess"},{"name":"hide","when":["seen is at 1","screen is up"],"then":"seen is nothing","made_by":"guesser first guess"}]}

Correct every mistake you find. Write the whole corrected model. If you find no mistake, write it unchanged.
